rules.detection_requirement: Detect repeated visible motion trajectory or near-duplicate frame sequence; stable holds are excluded.
Any repeated physical motion segment introduced for duration fit fails.
CTA gesture must be present once as a complete onset→peak→release chain; repeating only tail motion fails.
Verified result/readable boundary must occur before out cut.
Repeated reset/replay requires explicit editorial purpose; otherwise fail.
Allow sustained low-motion hold only when periodicity/trajectory checks show it is not a cyclic motion loop.

required_order: Run before edit-quality or imitation metrics.
